rows.en:
(Hmm, I came to Deep Akihabara by myself,
but maybe I should've invited someone...)
rows.notes: x3, both genders, frd_mcl_116. Deep Akihabara (glossary).

rows.en:
What are you doing in a place like this,
\p?

Oh, Michel.
I just came to hang out in Deep Akihabara.
What about you, Michel? What brings you here?

Actually, I was thinking of
checking out a maid cafe...
rows.notes: x2, Michel (joking, see c10470). maid cafe as 'butler cafe' in slice 110.

rows.en:
What?! A maid cafe?!
A-are you serious, Michel?!

Geez, obviously I'm joking.
Don't actually believe me, \p.
R-right... Of course you are!

You've got nothing to do, right?
I'm done shopping and free too,
so let's stop by the arcade or something.

(Michel going to a maid cafe...
Phew~, I'm really glad that was a joke...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
I just came to hang out in Deep Akihabara.
What about you, Michel-kun? What brings you here?

What?! A maid cafe?!
A-are you serious, Michel-kun?!
R-right... Of course you are!

(Michel-kun going to a maid cafe...
Phew~, I'm really glad that was a joke...)

Oh, Michel.
I was just wandering around with nothing to do.
What about you, Michel? What were you up to?
Just doing a little shopping.

If you've got nothing in particular to do,
well, I'm done shopping and free too,
so let's stop by the arcade or something.

(Hanging out at the arcade with Michel
was a nice change of pace today.)

(Hmm, I came to Deep Akihabara by myself,
but maybe I should've invited someone...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
I was just wandering around with nothing to do.
What about you, Michel-kun? What were you up to?

(Hanging out at the arcade with Michel-kun
was a nice change of pace today.)

(I promised to go shopping with Shirakawa,
but...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_myk_001. Shirakawa = Miyuki Shirakawa (female); the male player uses her bare surname.

rows.en: Shirakawa's late...
Hey, Shirakawa.
Hello, \p-kun.

You seem kinda stiff. What's up?
Are you nervous?
I'm not nervous at all.
Okay. Well, as long as you're fine.
Well, well, but this is...

Wh-what is it?
Please don't stare at me like that...

It's just, seeing you in casual clothes
feels kinda fresh, Shirakawa.
rows.notes: Male. shifuku = casual clothes (not the uniform).

rows.en: Oh, um, is that so...

Your casual clothes suit you, too.
You look cute.
Ah! Wh-what are you SAYING?!
rows.notes: Miyuki, flustered; the Japanese writes desuka in katakana for a stilted, cracked delivery, rendered with caps.

rows.en: Hm? Did I say something weird?
Yes, you did! Honestly, what is with you?!
Oh, honestly! Let's just go already!!
Wait, where are you going? Not that way!
I know that!
Today was fun.

I got to see you know a ton about tea, too.
You're amazing, Shirakawa!
I don't think it's anything special.
Hmm, you don't have to be so modest.

There are plenty of people
who know a lot about it.

Well, no one around me ever knew
as much about it as you do, Shirakawa...

And getting to see you in such cute casual
clothes was great too, Shirakawa.
Today was a really nice change of pace.
Oh, come on, stop it!
Hahaha, well then, shall we head home?

Yes.
Well then, see you at school.

(Wow, a real young lady, all right.
She looks so dignified even walking away...)
rows.notes: x2, both genders. ojousama = young lady of good family (Miyuki is from an elite family).

rows.en:
(I made plans to go shopping with Miyuki,
but...)
rows.notes: Female; the female player uses her given name.

rows.en: Miyuki's late...
Oh, Miyuki.

Huh, you seem kinda stiff... What's up?
Are you nervous?
Okay. Well, if you say so...
Hmm, hmm...

It's just, seeing you in casual clothes
feels kinda fresh, Miyuki.
You look super cute!
You're cute when you're embarrassed, too!

Oh, stop teasing me!
Come on, let's go.
Today was fun, wasn't it?

I got to see you know a ton about tea, too.
You're amazing, Miyuki!

Well, no one around me ever knew
as much about it as you do, Miyuki...

And getting to see you in such cute casual
clothes was great too, Miyuki.
Today was a really nice change of pace.
Hahaha, well then, let's head home.

rows.notes: Male. Playful 'sensei' for Miyuki as tea teacher. koucha = (black) tea.

rows.en: (Shirakawa's late...)
I'm sorry I'm late.
It's fine. I just got here myself.

You seem like the type who'd say that
to anyone.
Th-that's not true!
I'm kidding.
It doesn't sound like you're kidding!
Hehe... Now, shall we go?
rows.notes: Miyuki (kusukusu). Review: Miyuki's kusukusu/kusu is 'Hehe' (as elsewhere).

rows.en: Thanks, I found some good water.

It also depends on how it suits the tea leaves,
so ask me again when you brew
other kinds of tea.

I see. There's a lot more to it
than I thought...
That's what makes it fun.
Well then, I'll be going now.
(Okay, time to head home and have some tea~)

uncertain: c10497: Miyuki's flustered line writes desuka in katakana (stilted, voice cracking); rendered as 'Wh-what are you SAYING?!' with caps.
c10529/c10544: the player jokingly calls Miyuki 'Shirakawa-sensei' / 'Miyuki-sensei' as their tea teacher; honorific kept as in the Japanese.
